title: Engram Harness Evidence Receipt v1
description: Schema for revision-bound evidence receipts generated by trusted execution in the Engram harness.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier for the evidence receipt.

timestamp.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp when evidence was collected, ending with Z.

commit_sha.description: Target Git commit SHA (40-character lowercase hexadecimal).

task_id.description: Optional task identifier corresponding to the executed task specification.

base_sha.description: Base Git commit SHA (40-character lowercase hexadecimal).

tree_sha.description: Git tree SHA for the verified worktree state.

verdict.description: Overall verdict of the execution run.

checks.description: List of individual check execution results.

exit_code.description: Exit code returned by the check command.

duration_ms.description: Duration of check execution in milliseconds.

message.description: Short human-readable summary of check result.

command.description: Command label or approved argv representation.

log_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the full command execution log.

sha256_manifest.description: Map of repo-relative paths to their verified SHA-256 digest.

recorder.description: Identity of the trusted evidence recorder.
